title: Bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Sanhedrin 27a relates that he killed a person. The Exilarch told Rav Abba bar Yaakov, “Go and investigate the matter; if he certainly killed, put out his eyes.” Rav Pappi found grounds in his favor. Bar Chama rose and kissed Rav Pappi’s feet and undertook to pay his taxes for the rest of his life.

notes.text: Rashi explains the eye punishment as putting out the eyes, while also recording interpretations involving compensation to the heirs or excommunication. The story continues on Sanhedrin 27b, which reads feet and לכרגיה, his tax; the supplied notice has לכרניה.
